title: Amazon S3 to AWS Lambda to Amazon Translate
description: Trigger a Lambda function from S3 object created to start an Amazon Translate task.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern contains a sample AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) template that deploys a Lambda Function with an S3 object created trigger to start an Amazon Translate Task and place the results in another S3 bucket.
This pattern deploys one Lambda Function and two S3 Buckets.
